source.heading: Part VIII: Inspiration Tables > Something Especially Good (on a 6)

rows.text: Gains an unexpected ally: a third party offers support
Learns something: roll a Secret of a faction involved
Establishes a fact that will support its next action in the same area
Weakens a rival: move the opposing faction down one place in Standing
Wins goodwill: one AA involved moves +1 disposition toward the actor
Eases the crisis locally: push the Crisis Clock back one box

source.heading: Part VIII: Inspiration Tables > Something Especially Bad (on a 1)

rows.text: Is exposed: a covert action or a private fact becomes public
Provokes backlash: one AA involved moves −1 disposition toward the actor
Loses an asset: a bonus, a holding, or a relationship
Strengthens a rival: move the opposing faction up one place in Standing
Overreaches: the attempt creates a new vulnerability; add it to the Position
Worsens the crisis: advance the Crisis Clock one box
Was witnessed: name who saw it
Cost more than planned
Alarmed someone: the faction most affected now has a reason to act
Set a precedent others can invoke
Opened a door for someone else
Is incomplete: one piece remains, to be finished later

source.heading: Part VIII: Inspiration Tables > Force of Nature

rows.text: Weather or terrain: a storm, a flood, a collapsed road
Disease, fire or disaster
Popular unrest: a crowd, a strike, a riot
An outside power takes an interest
An economic shock: a failed harvest, a collapsed price
The past returns: a dead person's letter, an old claim, a forgotten treaty
